To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the environmental impact of bio-based films is mainly determined by the raw material extraction and manufacturing phases, whereas their end of life is the least contaminant stage.

the manufacture of bio-based films is the most contaminating stage for chitosand and agar films, and the extraction of raw soybeans is the stage with highest environmental burden for the soy protein film.

the manufacture stage is the most pollutant phase of the life cycle of the bio-based films prepared with chitosan and marine residues, whereas the extraction is the most polluting stage in the case of soy protein films.
